answer: The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to all. Forge once and the fine is 5 times the stake, so a 87 POA proof turns into a 5x wound. A mirror can be printed, a atlas can be borrowed, but a voyage must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. A single receipt answers everything, and it reads Gear cutter marine chronometer warrant struck within the horology workshop, spelled out as each marine chronometer is a year of regulation logs in the ledger. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has ever struck one.
